My Election Day
Your election information is based on where you reside. Enter your Mississippi residential address to:
  • Locate your polling place
  • Find upcoming elections & view sample ballots
  • View your current Office Holders
NOTICE: Polling location information is provided and updated by local election officials. It is recommended you confirm your polling place with your county circuit clerk. Contact information for your local election official will appear in a box on the right after you enter your address below.
Please type in your residential address slowly to allow My Election Day to locate your address and provide a list of addresses for your selection. Example:
Address Search Tips:
  • When entering your street address, include House Number, Street Name and City
